subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should configured agentDir become a prompt-instruction source, or should OpenClaw keep workspace as the only bootstrap source and warn when bootstrap files are misplaced in agentDir?
rationale: Current code and docs are workspace-only, but the linked fixes split between changing prompt authority and adding diagnostics; automation cannot choose that security/product boundary safely.

options.title: Confirm warning-only policy
options.body: Keep workspace as the canonical bootstrap source, land a cleaned warning/docs fix such as the warning-only PR, and treat per-agent prompt customization through per-agent workspace config.

options.title: Adopt explicit agentDir loading
options.body: Allow explicitly configured agentDir bootstrap files to override or merge with workspace files, but require precedence docs, diagnostic alignment, tests, and redacted live-run proof before merge.

options.title: Keep issue open for design
options.body: Pause all linked PRs until maintainers write the accepted workspace versus agentDir bootstrap contract.

recommendation.title: Confirm warning-only policy
recommendation.body: Keep workspace as the canonical bootstrap source, land a cleaned warning/docs fix such as the warning-only PR, and treat per-agent prompt customization through per-agent workspace config.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and repeatedly maintained the central bootstrap resolver surface where this policy lands.
